transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, I guess what really brought me in is... I've been having this issue when people are talking to me, especially my wife. 

She’ll be telling me about things—like my cousin’s appointments or figuring out his rides—and I’m looking right at her while she speaks. I'm paying attention, or so I think. But then a minute later, I realize I didn’t actually take in half of what she just said. It just sort of goes right past me, and I wanted to see what's going on with that.
Do you ever feel like you can hear people talking but still can’t make out the words they’re saying?

No, it's not like that. I can hear the words perfectly fine. My hearing is good. It's just that the meaning doesn't always stick, or my mind wanders off while they're talking. It's not a hearing problem, it's more like a listening problem, if that makes sense.
Looking back to when you were a child, did you often have the same kind of trouble paying attention when people were talking to you?

Yeah, I did, actually. Even way back in grade school, definitely before I was 12, it was an issue. I remember my teachers would always tell my parents that I was a bright kid, but I was just constantly daydreaming. My mind would just be somewhere else. 

It affected other things too back then. I was always leaving my homework inside my desk, and the teachers constantly had to give me reminders just to finish my regular classwork. So, yeah, this isn't exactly a new thing for me.
At work, do you also have trouble staying focused on what people are saying or on tasks?

Well, I'm actually not working right now, but I do volunteer work for my parish, and it definitely happens there. If I sit down to work out a catering order for an event, or if I'm listening in on a parish planning call... I usually start off fine. But before long, my mind just wanders off. I end up having to go back over the same notes or details because it's like I never even read them in the first place. So, yeah, it definitely affects me when I'm trying to focus on tasks like that.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?
No, not really. I don't feel restless or have the urge to fidget or move around a lot. It's really just my focus that wanders, not my body.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

No, I haven't really been feeling down or depressed. I mean, it gets a little frustrating when I can't keep my mind on things, but my mood is generally fine. I'm not feeling sad or anything like that.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?
No, I wouldn't say I feel anxious or worried very often. I mean, I might get a little stressed if I'm behind on something for the parish, but it's nothing major. I don't really struggle with anxiety.
